messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: metering.anomaly detected in prod-eu (P2). token_delta rising vs baseline. suspected duplicate emissions from emitter service. alert: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1755554321 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): ack — I'm on it, paging billing + sre. @tom (billing-eng) @ashley (sre)

tom (billing-eng): on my way. can you drop the quick aggregates?

ashley (sre): seeing a sustained tokens/sec bump from emitter-frontend eu-1 after 02:10 UTC. retries spiking on 5xx. possible double-count on retry path.

maria (oncall): quick query run:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) AS tot, emitter FROM metering.v1_tokens
WHERE region = 'eu-1' AND ts >= now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY emitter ORDER BY tot DESC LIMIT 5;
```
results (approx): emitter-a: 1.16M, emitter-b: 980k, emitter-c: 310k, baseline ~ 280k

tom (billing-eng): that's ~3-4x baseline for some emitters. customer visible?

sophie (support): two support tickets opened in last 25m referencing unexpected overage flags: #7832, #7833. both EU customers.

ashley (sre): rolling short mitigation: disabling emitter retry logic in eu-1 for now. command: `kubectl -n emitter rollout restart deploy/emitter-frontend --context=eu-1` and patch retry policy to max_retries=0. starting deploy now.

kevin (eng-runtime): i'll shift routing to fallback model-compact for low-cost paths to reduce token volume where possible. doing gradual 5% -> 50% ramp.

maria (oncall): handoff: my shift ends in 30m. handing to tom for billing reconciliation and customer follow-up.

incident-bot: mitigation applied — emitter retry patch successful on eu-1 at 02:26 UTC. token_delta trending down (1.4x baseline).

tom (billing-eng): taking over. immediate plan: 1) run de-dup backfill to collapse suspected duplicate events, 2) reconcile per-customer token tallies against last known good, 3) prepare provisional credits for impacted customers. backfill ETA ~2h, reconciliation ongoing.

sophie (support): i'll draft a short customer note: "We observed inflated usage counts due to retry duplication in EU; we've applied mitigation and are reconciling; provisional credits will be applied if needed." share draft in #support-ops. :white_check_mark:

ashley (sre): adding temporary alert signature: `tokens_per_emitter / emitter_event_rate > 2.5` for 5m window to catch duplicate patterns.

tom (billing-eng): saved search for suspected dup events: `tag:dup_candidate AND region:eu-1` — kicking off backfill job now. will post progress every 30m.

maria (oncall): closing initial pager as mitigation in place, monitoring for 15m before fully resolved. reopen if token_delta > 1.8x.

ashley (sre): noted. will keep retry patch ready to revert if any side effects.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: 02:46 UTC — token_delta 1.2x baseline; customer overage flags reduced. continue recon/credits.

tom (billing-eng): ETA update — backfill pass ~1h30m remaining, reconciliation with customer owners next. I'll take postmortem action items: add dedupe at ingest, add end-to-end test for retry paths.

sophie (support): prepping comms and ticket updates.

kevin (eng-runtime): i'll follow up on routing changes after backfill completes.

maria (oncall): thanks team — handing full ownership to tom. closing thread from oncall side. :handshake:
